description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'SaleReturn' within the OpenCart admin extension, specifically for handling sale return reports. It includes methods for displaying report forms, processing report data, saving report settings, and generating report output views.

classes.name: SaleReturn
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating sale return reports within the OpenCart admin extension. Contains methods for displaying report forms, processing data, saving report configurations, and rendering reports.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the sale return report form. Loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumbs, and renders the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of report settings. Checks user permissions, saves settings if authorized, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates the sale return report page. Loads necessary language and models, sets up filter parameters, pagination, and view for the report.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on filters like date range, group, and return status. Returns report data as a string (likely JSON or HTML).

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists sale return reports by calling 'getReport' and outputting the result.
